question: What results are obtained by offering kumuda flowers and bakula flowers in oblation?
premises: Kumuda flowers are used as oblation material
Bakula flowers are used as oblation material
Kumuda brings affection from people and bakula brings unequalled prosperities
inference: Oblations with kumuda flowers bring affection from people, and with bakula flowers bring unequalled prosperities.
plain_english: With kumuda flowers comes affection from people, and with bakula flowers come unequalled prosperities.
